summary: The exact candidate is a substantial partial fix: real gfx950 compilation and numerical execution pass for alternate roots containing spaces, double quotes, or backslashes and for an arbitrary private PATH symlink to a complete toolkit. A valid root containing both quote types is explicitly rejected before compilation, so arbitrary valid alternate ROCm locations are not fully supported.

tests.what_was_measured: The base ran on gfx950 with max error 0.00e+00, but inspection shows it ignored the alternate-root variable and used the available /opt/rocm default; the image therefore cannot naturally reproduce the missing-default original failure.
Actual gpu-module-to-binary compilation, final ISA generation, and gfx950 vector addition; max error 0.00e+00 against Torch.
Actual gpu-module-to-binary compilation, final ISA generation, and gfx950 vector addition; max error 0.00e+00 against Torch.
PATH-only resolved-toolkit discovery followed by real compilation, final ISA generation, and gfx950 numerical execution; max error 0.00e+00.
Independent remaining counterexample: candidate rejects a valid toolkit root before gpu-module-to-binary with ValueError about both quote types.
Full unit suite; 1109 passed and 17 skipped.

gpu_execution.evidence: Candidate runs for quote, backslash, space, and arbitrary-PATH layouts each executed vector addition on AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 with maximum error 0.00e+00 against Torch a + b and emitted dumps through final ISA.

remaining_counterexamples: A valid alternate ROCm toolkit root whose pathname contains both a single quote and a double quote passes toolkit validation but is rejected before gpu-module-to-binary by quote_pass_option_value().
remaining_limitations: The reported gfx1250 GPU and ROCm 6 environment were unavailable; execution and compatibility there remain unverified.

The original missing-/opt/rocm failure could not be naturally reproduced because this image has a valid /opt/rocm-7.2.0 installation; the base comparison instead confirms that the alternate-root variable is ignored.
No native rebuild was performed because the candidate changes only Python; the prepared pinned native MLIR extension and LLVM were used.
